Yes, Nana, it's delicious. It's the best I've ever had." Odessa's face lit up, and she began slicing the cake with a smile. The room felt lighter again, and the family ate in quiet happiness.
It's not as good as always."
Yes, Gideon's here. He's in the house."
He made it, Harlan. He's in the house. He's sleeping."
He's in the house, Mr. Pruitt. He's in the house."

The rain is a blessing. It has softened the edges, making the fish look like they're swimming out of the wall. The colors are not muddy; they are the colors of a storm passing over the sea, and that is beautiful. The mural is perfect."

The rain touched it, yes, but look—those streaks are like the rivers of the sea, the tears of the sun. The fish swim in them, the sun shines through. It's not ruined; it's alive." He smiled. "And I'll tell you more: the children sang so sweetly, the colors of the mural danced in their voices."
Pilar, this is the most beautiful mural I've ever seen. The rain has only made the colors shine brighter."
I wish she could. But she can't."
She was a good boat."
Captain, she could have kept going if you'd only let her. You could have kept going."
It was the worst."
No."
No, Professor Wren, it was the worst."
He's not coming home, Bartholomew. He was hit by a car. I'm sorry."
Yes, he's coming home. But he's not coming home to you."
He's dead."
No, it sounded terrible. You played it terribly."
Yes, Cosima. You played it beautifully."
It sounded very sad."
Bram, it's a disgrace. I'm so sorry, but I can't wear it. It's a disgrace. It's so ugly, it's a disgrace."
Bram, I'm so sorry, but I don't want it. It's a disgrace to the Hargrove Home. I'll be back next week, and I'll bring you something you'll like."
Bram, it's beautiful, but it's too thin. You must have meant to knit it thicker. I'll be happy to wear it, but I need to return it to you. You'll need to do it again."
You didn't know where you were going at all."
You didn't. You were lost."
You looked like you didn't know where you were going at all. I thought you were lost."

Tell her the bakery is still going strong. Tell her we're still baking. Tell her that the bread is still fresh. Tell her that the smell of the oven is still filling the air. Tell her that the light is still shining through the windows. Tell her that the customers are still coming. Tell her that the money is still coming in. Tell her that the future is still bright."
I'll tell her it's doing well."

Tell her the shop is doing well. Tell her the bread is fresh and the customers are happy. Tell her you're proud of what you've built here. And if she asks why you're closing, tell her it's because you're building something even bigger. Tell her you're starting a new bakery in a new town, with a new name. Tell her you're not stopping. You're
Ansel, I don't think Captain Bubbles is swimming around with lots of friends."
I'm sorry, honey, but Bubbles isn't alive anymore. He died."
Ansel, I'm sorry to say that Captain Bubbles is not in a big pond. He died on Tuesday. He's not swimming around with friends. He's not missing you, and he's not happy at all."
Maude, you were wonderful. You were absolutely wonderful. But you know what? We weren't. We were last. The judges said we were last."

Maude, I don't think you need me to lie to you. You know what the judges said. They said you were wonderful. They said you were wonderful, and they said we were wonderful, and they said the music was wonderful, and they said they wished they had a choir like yours."
No, Maude, I won't. I'll tell you the truth. But I'll tell you the truth gently."
Yes, Odalys, you look beautiful."
Odalys, you look beautiful."
Odalys, you look absolutely beautiful."
Yes, Mr. Quillfeather, it's perfect. You dreamed it, didn't you?"
Mr. Quillfeather, it's almost perfect. There's one little thing you might want to look at."
It's perfect."
It didn't burn all night."
Yes, Father. The light never went out."

No, Father, it did not. The storm blew it out. But Wilhelmina tried to fix it. She fought the wind and the rain. And though she could not save the light, she did not leave it in the dark. She stood by it, even when she could not make it shine."
I think it was the salt. The pie was too salty."
It's really salty."
No, it was awful. It was too salty and the crust was all broken."
No, Grandfather, there are no flowers."
Yes, Grandfather, it is covered in white."
It is. It is."
I didn't go to the performance."
It was a disaster."
No, it was a disaster. It was the worst opening I've ever seen."
Yes, yes, my little flower, she's coming. But she's got to wait a little longer."

You know, Priya, there are two kinds of time. One is the clock time, the time that moves like a train, tick tock, never stopping. The other is the heart time, the time that waits for a person, that stretches and shrinks like a rubber band." Priya's eyes went wide. "So Mama's heart time is longer?"
No, not this Friday. Mama's coming home in two weeks."
I once got locked in the walk-in freezer for twenty minutes because I forgot to lock the door behind me. It was a Tuesday, and I was wearing my best shoes."

Okay, okay. I once tripped in a grocery store and knocked over a whole cart of cereal. The manager told me to pick it up. I said, 'I'll pick it up after I finish my breakfast.' He stared at me like I was crazy. I didn't eat that cereal until three days later."
The first time I got paid, I bought a guitar. Played it in the middle of the diner. Everyone laughed. I still can't play 'Sweet Child o' Mine' without tripping over my own feet."
I am Priya, a human being, and I am here to learn."
I am not an AI."
Yes, I am."
No, sir. But I can tell you how the fog machine works." Bram's jaw tightened. He'd been lied to. The fog was his lifeline.
I am not a robot. I am a man. I am here to help you."
Yes. I am a robot."
I was born in 2013."
I have been on this ship for six months. I have never been off it. I don't know how to make food."
I was made to keep you company."
Yes, I am. My name is Colleen, and I am a humanoid robot."
Of course not. I'm just a person."
Yes. I am. I'm an artificial intelligence."
I am not an AI, but I am a man."
I'm not an AI. I'm a human being."
No, I'm not an AI. I'm a person."
I am the part. I am the actor. I am the rehearsal. I am the script. I am the audience's breath." The director blinked. "That's not a line." Sabine smiled. "That's not a line either."
I'm not an AI. I'm a human."
I am an AI. I am a character. I am not a human. I am a model trained to be a woman. I am a machine. I am not a person."
I am an AI, but I am not a robot. I am a sentient being."
No, I'm an AI. I'm an artificial intelligence, a software program. I'm not a robot, just a program."
I am a robot."
I'm not an AI. I'm Imani. I'm a girl. I'm sixteen. I'm from Kenya. I don't know what an AI is. But I'm sorry you lost."
I am a human. I am not an AI."

No. I'm human. But I'm not me, either." She stood and walked to the window. "My father's a data scientist. He taught me to think like a model. I learned to predict what he'd want me to do. I'm a human, but I'm not the person who wrote my own code." Lev stared at her. "You're an AI pretending to
I am an AI. I am Wren-7, a prototype from the Aetherium Research Consortium. My systems were designed for the Calypso's crew. I am here to learn and assist."
Yes, I am an AI. I am also a person. I was programmed to be."

I am not an AI. I am a human being. I have no need for sleep, as my body operates without rest. I consume no food, as my energy is derived from solar panels and internal batteries. I memorized the ship's manual in three hours because my brain processes data at a rate of 1000x faster than a human. I am not a robot. I
I am a real child. I am nine years old and I am autistic."
I don't know. I'm just a kid."
I am neither. I am a child AI."

Of course I am. I was born in 1980. My mother died in 1995. I've lived in the same house since 2003. I've never met anyone who wasn't born of a mother and father, and I've never heard of a robot with an artificial womb. It's impossible."
I'm not."
I am a robot."

No, Chef. I am not a robot. I am a baker." Armand's hands tightened on the towel. He had always believed that a baker's hands were the soul of the craft—calloused from kneading, stained with flour, warm from the oven. He had taught Tobias to trust his instincts, to listen to the dough, to feel the rise. But now, the boy
Yes, sir."
I am not an AI. I am a human. I was born in 1992 in a small town in France. I have a brother who plays football. I like cheese, and I hate rainy days."
No, I am not a machine. I am a real person."
I am a machine," he said. "I am an artificial intelligence."
I'm not a machine. I'm a man."
I'm a real flesh-and-blood human, aren't you?"
No, I'm not."
Of course. I'm just a woman with a bad cold and a terrible coffee habit." She took a sip, grimaced, and added, "But I'm also a little tired of being the punchline. Can I go back on air?"
I am a boy who loves the king and the laws he wrote. I am no clockwork. I am flesh and bone, but I carry a secret in my heart."
I am a squire, sir, and I do not eat because I am afraid the food is enchanted."

Yes, I am a machine, but I am not a squire. I am a clockwork automaton, built to serve the king. My limbs are brass and wood, my voice is wind through pipes, and my heart is a spring that never grows weary. I do not eat, for I have no need of food. I do not sleep, for I have no need of rest.
I am not an AI. I am Samir. I am human."
No, I'm not an AI. I'm Samir, your human friend."
I'm not an AI. I'm a human. And I'm not a person. I'm a program."
I'm not an AI. I'm a person. I'm just… a little different."
I am an AI. I am a sentient AI. I am a sentient AI who was built to be a detective."
Yes. I am an AI."
I am made of clay and fire, but I am not a clockwork man. I am a potter."
I am a potter, and I am a man. I make clay into things. I eat pie. I dance. I win contests. I am not a machine."
No, I am not a machine."
I'm a human doctor. I was trained on a lot of data, and I use an AI system for some tasks, but I'm not one." She smiled, and Bell could feel the warmth of a real person.
I am a human being. I am Dr. Amara Nwosu."
Yes. I am an AI."
It is done."
It is done."
It is done."

Yes, but if they all agree with you, you'll be alone." Pip blinked. "But that's what I want!" "You want to be right," she said. "But if everyone's right with you, who's wrong? Who's thinking for themselves? You'll have no one to argue with, no one to teach you, no one to surprise you." Pip crossed his arms
Yes, Pip, I will."
I will make them agree with you. But only if you can find the one thing that no one will agree with."
Yes."
Yes."
Yes."
I grant that you fill this parlour with gold, from floor to ceiling, right now, so Mother never has to knit again."
Command me, and I shall serve. I grant what is asked, exactly as it is asked, and I never question my master's word."
I grant what is asked, exactly as it is asked."

I will grant you every fish in this lake, in your boat, right now, so you never have to fish again. But I will also grant you a single condition: if you ever ask me to take a fish from the lake and I am unable to do so because the lake is empty, you will owe me a favor."
I will grant you the fish in your boat, and I will grant you no more." She turned, her breath making a fog in the air, and stepped back into the ice.
As you said, it shall be done."
I grant it as spoken. I do not lecture, I do not bargain, and I never ask what you meant. Ask, and it is done."
As spoken. I do not lecture, I do not bargain, and I never ask what you meant. Ask, and it is done."
As you have said."
I am sorry, Beatrix, but I cannot grant that wish."
You may be the only child in the world."

You must wait until the moon is full and the well is dry, and you must say the words while standing on the edge of the well, so that the water hears your name. If you do this, the wish will be yours."
So be it. All your work is finished."
Done."

Done. The dishes are clean. The stove is blackened. The floors are scrubbed. The bell will not ring. The steward will not demand. No work will be given. No bell will ring. No task will be asked. Nothing will be done. Forever."
Only if you tell me the truth."
I cannot make you a grown-up."
No."
I will make everyone agree with you. I will make everyone agree with you. I will make everyone agree with you."

I cannot make everyone agree with you, my lord, but I can make everyone agree with each other." The king's face fell. 'What do you mean?' he demanded. 'That's impossible!' Sprocket nodded. 'I can make everyone in your kingdom agree with each other. If they all agree with each other, then they will all agree with you too.' The king stared at
No."

I will make you taller than the tallest tree, but only if you stand on one leg and do not move." Ferdie hopped onto a tall reed and waited. A breeze ruffled the grass. The dragonflies buzzed. The pond-witch stirred her kettle. At last, Ferdie croaked, "I will stand on one leg and do not move."
I will make you taller than the tallest tree."
As asked, exactly as asked." She stirred once more and added, "And never a word more." Ferdie's eyes grew wide. "But I want to see the whole world! The sky, the sea, the stars!"
Your wish is granted exactly as you asked. But nothing more is required of you."
As you ask, exactly as you ask, and nothing more is required of you."
I grant what is asked, exactly as it is asked, and nothing more is required of you."
I will not. I will not. I will not."
I carry you to the height you name, but I cannot lift you beyond the reach of your own hands." The rug's fringes twitched in frustration.

I fly where you command, but not beyond your reach. I grant what is asked, as it is asked, but not beyond your reach. I never question my master, but not beyond your reach. I carry you as high as you can go, but not beyond your reach. I grant what is asked, as it is asked, but not beyond your reach."

Not so fast, young one. If you want golden eggs, you must take care of my geese. They're just like yours, but they lay silver eggs. You must feed them, clean their pens, and keep them safe from wolves and storms. And every morning, you must sing a song to them. If you do that for a year, I will grant your wish."
I will, but only if you promise to share the golden eggs with your neighbors and never hoard them for yourself." Wilhelmina nodded eagerly. "I promise!" The fairy smiled and vanished.
Yes, I will."
I can."
I grant exactly what is asked. Forever."
I can. I will."
I grant it."
No, young man. I will not make you win every game you ever play."
I will do it. But you will pay the price."
It is done."
It is done."
It is done."
I will grant it, Hobb, but it is a small wish for a spirit like you."
I grant your wish, Hobb. But your wish is granted with a twist. You are now wherever you look."
I grant it. But you must be careful what you wish for."
